events.title: 30 Years Since Tupac Shakur's Death
events.blurb: On this day, 30 years ago, rapper Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas, dying six days later on September 13, 1996. He would have been 55.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Tupac Shakur today, 30 years after the tragic events in Las Vegas. His influence on hip-hop and music culture remains as powerful as ever. What's your go-to Tupac track?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of guitar icon Jimi Hendrix in 1970. He would have been 84.

angles.name: Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: The world lost a true legend on this day with the passing of Jimi Hendrix. His groundbreaking guitar work continues to inspire generations. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Released (1969)
events.blurb: The iconic Beatles album 'Abbey Road' was released in 1969, featuring tracks like 'Come Together' and 'Here Comes the Sun'. It was the last album the group recorded.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: It's the anniversary of The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' album release! That iconic cover, those legendary tracks. Which song from Abbey Road is on repeat for you?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! From 'Brass in Pocket' to 'Don't Get Me Wrong', her voice and style are unmistakable.

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis icon and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! The voice of a generation and still rock 'n' rolling. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Released (1975)
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: On this day, John Lennon's powerful message of peace, 'Imagine', was released. A song that still resonates globally. What does 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: The First iPod Launched (2001)
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember this? 25 years ago today, the original iPod dropped! Suddenly, 1,000 songs in your pocket was a reality. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated worldwide as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', premiering in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, the world's most famous spy always delivers. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate Bond song?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: The legendary John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the extraordinary John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire. What's your favourite Lennon track, solo or with The Beatles?

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: Iconic comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedy genius, John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his work is simply legendary. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Released (1968)
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, famously known as the 'White Album', was released in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: It's the anniversary of The Beatles' incredible 'White Album' release! Over 30 tracks of pure genius. Which one stands out for you?

events.title: 35 Years Since Freddie Mercury's Death
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the music world lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury in 1991. He would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Freddie Mercury, 35 years on. His voice, his stage presence, his music – truly one of a kind. What's your ultimate Queen track?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Released (1965)
events.blurb: The groundbreaking Beatles album 'Rubber Soul' was released in 1965, featuring tracks like 'Drive My Car' and 'Norwegian Wood'.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: An absolute classic turns another year older! The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day. A pivotal album for the Fab Four. What's your favourite track from it?

events.title: 46 Years Since John Lennon's Death
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon in 1980. He would have been 86.

angles.name: John Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years since we lost a true music icon. His legacy continues to inspire generations worldwide. What's the song that best captures his spirit for you?
